text: TSMC suspends some shipments, non-Chinese and non-AI developers hit Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. is the world's largest contract chipmaker, producing leading-edge AI processors for customers such as Nvidia. (Photo by Rebecca Noble) TAIPEI -- Tighter U.S. export controls introduced Thursday are having a far broader impact on the global semiconductor supply chain than initially expected, extending beyond advanced AI chips to those used in everyday mobile and consumer applications and affecting developers beyond China, multiple industry executives told Nikkei Asia.
